verdict.rationale: Paperspace's docs live on docs.digitalocean.com, which serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200). The Paperspace API reference is available as a markdown (.md) page, and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec is served at api.paperspace.com/v1/openapi.json, so an agent has some agent-consumable entry points. However, the llms.txt is DigitalOcean-wide with no shown Paperspace-specific coverage, and the Paperspace product-page .md variant returns 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes Paperspace content, consistent markdown variants across Paperspace product docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.digitalocean.com/llms.txt # DigitalOcean Documentation
Programmatically manage Paperspace resources using conventional HTTP requests
The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
